import_policy: Import exactly 247 parent tasks into Astra One project_queue. Attach subtasks as child records; do not create separate top-level tasks for each child.
dispatch_policy: After read-only preflight and explicit operator start, dispatch only dependency-ready parents; max five active parents, one per worker.
quota_policy: If Codex quota is exhausted, pause without retry consumption. Do not silently substitute a model.
github_actions_policy: Do not trigger remote GitHub Actions while monthly build quota is exhausted. Run local checks and mark remote-only acceptance pending.
repository_policy: Use the existing admindeveloper4562/A.R.C.H.O.N repository. Do not create a duplicate repository.
handover_policy: Astra One remains the active external builder until native SDA passes all migration qualification gates and explicit owner approval.
